scientific_intent.domain: Molecular nonbonded Lennard-Jones and Ewald-correction cluster force operator
scientific_intent.scientific_question: Preserve a standalone GROMACS-derived clustered force calculation and validate active-pair, exclusion, self-triangle and shifted-force paths.
scientific_intent.mathematical_operation: Float32 cluster-list LJ plus screened Coulomb/Ewald correction with masked exclusions, warp reductions and particle/shift atomic accumulation.
scientific_intent.classification_rationale: Source GROMACS-derived molecular pair-force operator; its execution motif is blocked pair interaction rather than a complete trajectory or reciprocal PME solver.
scientific_intent.community_use_case: Molecular force-kernel developers assessing masked pair-list semantics and CUDA-specific collective mappings.
scientific_intent.support_boundary: Original 3199 superclusters/204808 atoms/10000 repeats for both shift flags, plus four nonzero/self/exclusion/cutoff controls. Original masks all zero: no physical pair arithmetic in default. Source GPU body unchanged; common explicitly resident managed-data study, not full GROMACS/PME/integrated MD or original first-touch latency.
scientific_intent.accuracy_requirements: All nine actual device buffers byte-compared against six full native canonical readbacks every trial/model; full force and 45 shift vectors, 2462658 Float64-encoded Float32 values/trial, 1231362 exact-prefix values. Full independent analytic LJ/Ewald pair oracle at .002+1e-4*abs(ref); exact default/tails/untouched fields; normalized Newton<=5e-5; nonfinite rejected.
